_doc: JAM_CLASS_BUILD_OPS_DETECTOR_PER_CLASS (design/RimMandrake/relentless_improvement_loop_2026-11-03.md, owner 2026-11-03: "absolutely, fix the class should be the rule."). Every Relentless jam is fixed as a CLASS: one row here with a plain name a cold reader understands, the Operations detector that sees it (an ops_watch_rules.json target), and an automatic remedy (a function that exists) or the reason none is safe. jam_classes.py lint holds every row to that; ops_watch reads the belt's journal through jam_classes.census every pass: relentless.jam_unnamed counts jams no class here matches (name the class), relentless.jam_repeat counts jams of a class after its fix (the fix did not hold: fix the class again, then move fixed.at). A jam is a journal alarm of a kind in `kinds`; its reason is the alarm's why with the breaker prefix removed. `examples` are reasons the belt really journaled; lint requires each to match its own class and no other.

classes.plain: The clone pool was full and no clone could be given back, so no new worker could start.

detector.how: relentless.distressed: the staffing reading names the pool hold as the cause of nothing live

remedy.what: each tick gives back idle and put-down clones before a lease; a held, blocked or game-waiting item's clone goes back with all its commits

examples: pool full: 16 clones, cap 16, nothing to release: BIOME_FLORAFAUNA_ART_REVIEW_1 (live), CLIFF_SHOT_FIX_DEPENDS_ON_SHOOTER_END (live)
pool at 71 GB, cap 70 GB (the revert line)

classes.plain: The belt's own copy of the code had stray edited files in it, so it stopped taking new code.

detector.how: relentless.books_behind_min: minutes the books clone has stood behind origin

remedy.what: levels the books past reordered ledger shards, run artefacts, the paths BOOKS_LEFT_IN_PLACE names and any untracked file origin does not track (drop_stray_untracked); a tracked stray edit is the class coming back

examples: books 2 behind: dirty outside the ledger: infrastructure/state/modcheck_status.json, Transient/northstar/ArtFold_20261103T121727Z.json

classes.plain: GitHub refused this machine's key, so no code could be fetched or pushed.
match: Could not read from remote repository

detector.how: relentless.books_behind_min reads UNMEASURED and relentless.blind counts it; the breaker it opens shows in relentless.distressed

remedy.none: The key and GitHub are outside the belt: a GitHub outage reads as this same denial (lesson 2026-11-04), so the only safe act is the retry the breaker already makes; replacing a key is the owner's

examples:
books cannot fetch: git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
clone failed: scratch_clone: FAILED: git fetch -q origin: git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey).

classes.plain: A fresh clone did not have a just-published commit, so checking it out failed.

detector.how: relentless.distressed: the breaker this failure opens holds the belt under target

remedy.what: a checkout whose sha or tree is absent fetches that sha from origin once before failing; pool reuse honours --fetch (scratch_clone.pool_reuse)

examples: checkout 567b22fad99acbaaa9ef388b1699e474d3b420f4: fatal: unable to read tree (567b22fad99acbaaa9ef388b1699e474d3b420f4)

classes.plain: A second-opinion helper's folder from an earlier try was still there, so a new one could not be made.

detector.how: relentless.distressed: the breaker this failure opens holds the belt under target

remedy.what: a consult takes the first help-ITEM-cN folder name nobody holds; the leftover is the reaper's, never deleted here

examples: help clone failed: scratch_clone: FAILED: /home/mandrake/rm/relentless/clones/help-ROLE_TOKENS_REPAIR_DESIGNER_ARTIST_CAPS-c1 already exists

classes.plain: Carrying a clone's work home failed because the file list was too long for one command.

detector.how: relentless.distressed: the breaker this failure opens holds the belt under target

remedy.what: the bundle leaves pool noise out by prefix and never lists every path on one command line

examples: clone lacks src/RimMandrake/Utils/claude_bounded.sh and its bundle failed: [Errno 7] Argument list too long: 'git'

classes.plain: The day's spending limit stopped new workers from starting.

detector.how: relentless.distressed: the staffing reading names the cap as why nothing runs

remedy.none: Nothing to undo: since the owner's 2026-11-02 ruling the cap only raises attention and never stops a run (relentless.py, TOKEN_LIMITS_TAME_BARK_NO_BITE), so a stop by it is the class coming back

classes.plain: The Claude account itself refused the run (a usage limit or login error), so no worker could do any work.
match: ^the run ended on the account's own error:

detector.how: relentless.distressed: the launch breaker the account errors open names the account as why nothing runs

remedy.what: a run lost to the account costs the item no strike, no return and no change of approach; it is requeued at its place and the launch breaker waits for the account to answer

examples: the run ended on the account's own error: rate_limit

classes.plain: A worker died the moment it started without spending anything, usually the account refusing it before any work.
match: died at once with no usage$

detector.how: relentless.distressed: the launch breaker these deaths open holds the belt under target and names the dead unit

remedy.what: a run dead inside launch_grace_s with no tokens and no beat goes back to the line at its place with no strike, and charges the launch breaker, which waits before the next start

examples: rm-relentless-work-2f7d7ad7e9-g24 died at once with no usage

classes.plain: Degraded health paused content for system items that could not start, so nothing ran at all.
match: ^health degraded: content paused while system items wait

detector.how: relentless.distressed: nothing live while work waits reads distressed, its cause the health pause

remedy.what: a system item the concept gate refuses (it waits on a Designer pass, not a place) no longer keeps content paused; a repeat means another kind of unstartable system item holds the pause

examples: health degraded: content paused while system items wait

classes.plain: Builders were paused because too many finished items waited for a check, though the ones waiting were only sitting out a timer and no checker was busy.

detector.how: relentless.distressed: nothing live while work waits reads distressed, its cause the check_backlog wait

remedy.what: the check_backlog pause counts only candidates a Judge can take this tick; one waiting out an UNMEASURED recheck (recheck_at) is not in the line. A repeat means the checkers really are the bottleneck: raise check_backlog_max or the check places

classes.plain: The belt's own copy of the code held ledger lines it had written but not yet published, so it refused to take new code until they landed.

detector.how: relentless.books_behind_min: minutes the books clone has stood behind origin

remedy.what: the tick-start sync and every mid-tick serve flush (publish) the belt's own ledger shards first, then level; a repeat means the flush itself is failing (its why is what books_alarm then reports)

examples: books 4 behind: 1 lines of infrastructure/state/ledger/events/BENCH.jsonl not landed
